lines.name: Purple Line
lines.notes: PCMC to Swargate. Official colour name Purple Line is printed on the 15 Aug 2025 timetable. Alignment length 17.4 km is from the project profile. The timetable image prints 17.5 km and 34 minutes.

lines.name: Aqua Line
lines.notes: Vanaz to Ramwadi. Official colour name Aqua Line is printed on the 15 Aug 2025 timetable. Alignment length 15.7 km is from the project profile. The timetable image prints 14.5 km and 37 minutes.

lines.name: Purple Line, Nigdi extension
lines.notes: PCMC to Nigdi, 4.413 km, four elevated stations. The Line 1B page says this northern extension is under construction. Station order is the order printed on the project profile, which does not explicitly say it runs from PCMC toward Bhakti Shakti.

lines.name: Purple Line, Katraj extension
lines.notes: Sanctioned Swargate to Katraj underground extension, 5.46 km. Stations named by Maha Metro: Market Yard, Padmavati, Katraj. Not open.

lines.name: Aqua Line, Chandani Chowk extension
lines.notes: Vanaz to Chandani Chowk, 1.12 km, two stations: Kothrud Bus Depot and Chandani Chowk. Not described as open.

lines.name: Aqua Line, Wagholi extension
lines.notes: Ramwadi to Wagholi/Vitthalwadi, 11.63 km, 11 stations in the official numbered list. Not described as open.

lines.name: Line 4
lines.notes: Kharadi to Khadakwasla, 25.52 km, 22 elevated stations. The official page does not name the stations, so none were created.

lines.name: Line 4A
lines.notes: Spur described as Nal Stop–Warje–Manik Baug, 6.12 km, 6 elevated stations. Individual station names were not published, so none were created.

lines.name: Line 3
lines.notes: Hinjawadi/Maan to District Court, 23.203 km, 23 elevated stations, published by PMRDA. Opening of individual stations is only partly documented. The amber colour is an app display colour. PMRDA and the operator pages checked on 4 Nov 2026 did not publish an official line colour. OpenStreetMap tags the corridor Pink Line; that tag was not adopted as branding. The operator site lists line-wide facilities: lifts and escalators, wheelchair ramps, tactile paths, priority seating, accessible toilets, ticket counters, QR ticketing, drinking water, and first aid at all stations. It also says an occupational health centre is available at a few stations, without naming them. These are not stored as inspected facilities of each station.

interchanges.notes: PMRDA describes Line 3 as the Hinjawadi to Shivajinagar corridor, and the operator's terminus is District Court, Pune. Maha Metro's interchange is also named District Court, with Civil Court used on one route-map listing. Walking time and whether the transfer is inside the paid area were not published.
